verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce product catalog API, so issuing scoped payment credentials to agents is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no scoped or limited-use credential feature with amount limits, expiry, or merchant restrictions. The only payment-related item is that agents can pay for Channel3's own API usage via MPP, which is an adjacent capability and not a delegated user credential.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand my agent a scoped, limited-use payment credential — amount limits, expiry, merchant restrictions — instead of a raw card number
